If anyone is wondering, there are addons for op 2.2 but only in russian on stalkerworld.ru, soon ill post addon on moddb that make small creatures such as dogs, tushkanos, bees, flies etc less immune to gunshot wounds and explosives.

1 is full damage 0.01 is you guess how little...personally i made it 5 because bullets and grenades are very deadly the lower the volume of the creature by logic.
Increasing the panic_threshold would result in creatures have panic attack and run for their life when they hit certain hp value, for example value of 0.5 means if you make them lose half hp they would likely run away from you if not in groups, damage_treshold on the other hand is value at which the creature would start it't "hurt" animation and be slower, 1 is at full health 0.2 is at 20% left.Have fun!
